decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper extends the firm's established dumper line, so keeping it costs little, and one year on the market reveals too little to justify abandoning the option.
The articulated dumper uses existing engineering, service and logistics capabilities, so carrying it is cheap while its market value is still being revealed.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and carries higher uncertainty, but it opens a specialized underground niche with long sales cycles, so the option is worth holding until more evidence arrives.
The compact telescopic loader builds on the established lifting range at low incremental cost, and its prospects remain uncertain after only one year, so the option should stay open.
